findings.source_quote: Τί οὖν, φημί, κύριε, ἐὰν οὗτοι οἱ ἄνθρωποι, τοιοῦτοι ὄντες, μετανοήσωσι
findings.english_quote: “Sir,” I said, “what if these people repent?
findings.issue: The simplified opening omits τοιοῦτοι ὄντες, which explicitly acknowledges these people's existing condition within the hypothetical question. Referring merely to “these people” does not preserve that qualification.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed opening: “Then, sir,” I said, “what if these people, even though they are like this, repent?” Review this proposal together with the remaining clauses to preserve their shared conditional scope.

findings.source_quote: τί δοκεῖς τοὺς κεκλημένους ὑπ᾿ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ὄνομα φοροῦντας τοῦ υἱοῦ [τοῦ Θεοῦ] καὶ πορευομένους ταῖς ἐντολαῖς αὐτοῦ;
findings.english_quote: what do you think of those he has called? They bear the Son of God’s name and walk in his commandments.
findings.issue: The source groups being called, bearing the name, and walking in the commandments as coordinated descriptions of the people under discussion. Ending the question after “called” and adding an independent assertion makes name-bearing and obedience assertions about those called as a whole, rather than preserving the source's combined description.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed replacement: “what do you think of those he has called, who bear the Son of God’s name and walk in his commandments?” Retain the existing disclosure that the repeated “of God” phrases are bracketed supplements, and review the replacement afresh.

findings.source_quote: Τί οὖν, φημί, κύριε, ἐὰν οὗτοι οἱ ἄνθρωποι, τοιοῦτοι ὄντες, μετανοήσωσι
findings.english_quote: Retain conditional repentance, all names and stone counts, water/seal and life/death imagery; preserve all substantive alternative notes.
findings.issue: The simplification metadata claims preservation of stone counts and water/seal imagery, neither of which occurs anywhere in this selected section. This is an inaccurate description of the actual source coverage, not evidence of fidelity for this unit.
findings.suggested_revision: Replace the generic metadata with a unit-specific account of the conditional sequence, the two renewal expressions, the construction explanation, the name-bearing descriptions, and the disclosed supplements and alternatives. Do not claim retention of material absent from this source.

summary: The standard edition faithfully represents the selected working Greek, including its negations, necessity, repentance conditions, and difficult assertions. Its notes distinguish bracketed supplements and disclose alternatives without replacing the working reading. The simplified edition requires correction of an omitted qualification, an expanded assertion about those called, and inaccurate simplification metadata. This is a model review of the supplied text and attributed reports, not authentication of manuscript images or certification of exhaustive collation. Proposed revisions require fresh review.
